home: Pay with your face | facePay Demo
Explore facePay, an interactive checkout concept. Try a simulated face match, scan demo items and confirm a fictional payment. No real charges.
signup: Try facePay enrollment with fictional details, an animated face match and a test card. No real cards or biometric data are collected.
checkout: Try the facePay self-checkout: browse the demo catalog, scan barcodes, review your basket and confirm a simulated payment. No real charges.
account: View your browser-only facePay demo profile, fictional wallet and itemized receipts. Manage receipt previews or clear your local demo data.
business: Explore facePay for stores. Set up a fictional merchant, preview checkout and try a browser-only product catalog. This is not a live payment service.
dashboard: Preview the facePay store dashboard with clearly labeled sample analytics and a CSV catalog import for your local checkout demo.
security: Learn what the facePay prototype does, what stays in your browser and what a production payment service would need. No real payment or face matching.
notfound: This page is not in the facePay demo. Return home or try the self-checkout concept. No real payments are processed.
